FROM ubuntu:24.04

ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

RUN rm -f /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/docker-clean \
    && echo 'Binary::apt::APT::Keep-Downloaded-Packages "true";' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/keep-cache

# Auto-keep existing conffiles so apt never blocks the build on a prompt
RUN echo 'Dpkg::Options { "--force-confold"; "--force-confdef"; };' > /etc/apt/apt.conf.d/99haive-noninteractive

RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt/lists,sharing=locked \
    apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ca-certificates curl git gnupg bash jq ripgrep

# Node.js 22 (build-essential + python3 needed by node-gyp for native modules)
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt/lists,sharing=locked \
    curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | bash - \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends nodejs build-essential python3 pkg-config \
    && corepack enable

# Python 3.12
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt/lists,sharing=locked \
    apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends python3 python3-pip python3-venv

# Go 1.26.7
RUN curl -fsSL https://go.dev/dl/go1.26.7.linux-amd64.tar.gz | tar -C /usr/local -xz
ENV PATH="/usr/local/go/bin:${PATH}"

# Rust 1.98.0
RUN curl -fsSL https://sh.rustup.rs | sh -s -- -y --default-toolchain 1.98.0 --profile minimal
ENV PATH="/root/.cargo/bin:${PATH}"

# Ruby (whatever the base suite ships)
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt/lists,sharing=locked \
    apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends ruby ruby-dev build-essential

# Language servers
RUN npm install -g intelephense@1.2.3
RUN npm install -g intelephense@1.2.3
RUN npm install -g @vtsls/language-server@1.2.3 typescript
RUN pip install --break-system-packages pyright==1.2.3
RUN go install golang.org/x/tools/gopls@v1.2.3
RUN gem install solargraph -v 1.2.3
RUN rustup component add rust-analyzer
RUN curl -fsSL https://download.eclipse.org/jdtls/snapshots/jdt-language-server-latest.tar.gz -o /tmp/jdtls.tar.gz \
    && mkdir -p /opt/jdtls \
    && tar -xzf /tmp/jdtls.tar.gz -C /opt/jdtls \
    && rm /tmp/jdtls.tar.gz \
    && ln -s /opt/jdtls/bin/jdtls /usr/local/bin/jdtls

# Browser testing: headed browser + Xvfb/x11vnc/socat + puppeteer-core
# Ubuntu has no chromium deb (snap only) — take the browser from Google apt
RUN --mount=type=cache,target=/var/cache/apt,sharing=locked \
    --mount=type=cache,target=/var/lib/apt/lists,sharing=locked \
    install -m 0755 -d /etc/apt/keyrings \
    && curl -fsSL https://dl.google.com/linux/linux_signing_key.pub | gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/google-chrome.gpg \
    && chmod a+r /etc/apt/keyrings/google-chrome.gpg \
    && echo "deb [arch=$(dpkg --print-architecture) signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/google-chrome.gpg] https://dl.google.com/linux/chrome/deb/ stable main" > /etc/apt/sources.list.d/google-chrome.list \
    && apt-get update \
    && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends google-chrome-stable xvfb x11vnc socat procps fonts-dejavu \
    && ln -sf /usr/bin/google-chrome /usr/bin/chromium

RUN mkdir -p /opt/browser && cd /opt/browser && npm init -y >/dev/null 2>&1 && npm install puppeteer-core@22 >/dev/null 2>&1
ENV CHROME_PATH=/usr/bin/chromium
RUN /usr/bin/chromium --version | tee /etc/haive-browser-version

WORKDIR /workspace

CMD ["bash"]
